CN:这是我收藏的完整档案，包含 50 多个工作流程。我最后一次更新了其中的许多内容，以确保与当前版本的 Comfy UI 兼容。这是最终上传对于这个特定的页面。

我正在做一个干净的削减：从2026 年 1 月从那时起，我的所有工作流程都将专门使用我新的、有组织的布局。我不会发布一个庞大的、难以管理的集合，而是发布专门包（例如，Nunchaku Flux、Z-Image、SDXL、Pony 等）。

为什么？这使我能够保证质量并使所有内容保持最新状态，而不会丢失 50 多个单独文件的跟踪。

非常感谢您多年来的支持！请务必访问我YouTubeto stay tuned for the new era of workflows.该页面将不再维护。

德语：这是 50 个工作流程的完整存档。 Ich habe viele davon ein letztes Mal überarbeitet, damit sie mit der aktuellen Comfy UI Version kompatibel sind.死了上传(Final Upload) für diese Seite.

Ich mache jetzt einen klaren Schnitt：Ab2026 年 1 月我们将在新的工作流程中重新布局布局。 Anstatt einer riesigen, unhandlichen Sammlung werde ich特殊的帕克特veröffentlichen（z. B. Nunchaku Flux、Z-Image、SDXL、Pony usw.）。

瓦鲁姆？因此，请注意质量和行动保证，超过 50 个月后的日期。

Vielen Dank für euren jahrelangen 支持！Besucht mich unbedingt aufYouTube, um den Start der neuen Workflow-Ära nicht zu verpassen. Diese Seite wird ab sofort nicht mehr gepflegt.V12 我们的 Comfy UI 工作流程已更新到最新版本，并通过 SDXL、Flux、Nuchaku、Kolors、Ollama、F5TTS 和 WAN2.2 等强大工具进行了增强，可用于高级图像、视频和多媒体创建。

To use Nuchaku, you need an RTX graphics card, and you'll need to do a few things in addition to the custom node installation.这四个视频都解释了这一点。 A few days ago, a completely updated installation guide was also released for the model creators. Introducing the must-have AI Image Upscaling Workflow, your secret weapon for transforming ordinary images into extraordinary masterpieces. Packed with the power of SDXL and Flux, this innovative workflow will guide you step-by-step through the process of enhancing even the smallest details with precision and finesse. Say goodbye to blurry faces and hello to professional-quality results, all at the click of a button. Whether you're a seasoned AI artist or just starting out, this workflow is a game-changer you simply can't afford to miss!

  • Face Crop, Inpaint Optimize, and various Detailer options provide precise image manipulation

  • Face Swap, Upscaler, SD Ultimate, Supir, Loras, and ControlNet offer ultimate creative control

  • Image 2 Image allows for stunning image transformations

  • Stylers, Flux, and Kolors enable you to add unique artistic flair

  • SDXL ensures lightning-fast, high-quality upscaling

  • Integration of multiple samplers encourages versatile experimentation

  • Optimization of existing images guarantees top-notch quality

The Comfy Workflow offers a comprehensive set of tools and features to enhance your image generation experience. With the ability to create, modify, and optimize images using powerful samplers like SDXL, Kolors, and Flux, you have unparalleled control over your creative process. The workflow also includes advanced features such as Controlnet, various optimization tools, and the ability to upscale your images with ease.

Some key capabilities of the Comfy Workflow include:

  • Generating high-quality images using SDXL, Kolors, and Flux samplers

  • Employing Controlnet for enhanced image control and precision

  • Optimizing and refining images with powerful tools

  • Upscaling images with the Ultimate SD Upscaler

  • Saving and organizing images with customizable settings

The Comfy Workflow is designed to be user-friendly and adaptable to your needs, making it the ultimate tool for artists, designers, and anyone looking to push the boundaries of digital image creation.
